about_the_game:
ASHWAKE TECH DEMO

Experience a hardcore survival game with realistic weapon mechanics, level select functionality with progression elements, in-depth survival systems, crafting, PDA system, selling/buying with vendors, hostile NPCs, anomalies & infected, and more. Featuring only the first faction and base for the demo, tactical weapon handling, a variety of weapons, permadeath, demo quests, and extraction systems to safeguard your gear.

content_descriptors.notes: Ashwake contains consumption of alcohol and other substances as a way to improve or hurt player health. The only nudity present will be on monsters, corpses (very little), and posters/magazines.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / Intel Arc A750
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64 / Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700 / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / Nvidia GeForce RTX 4070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: ASHWAKE is a hardcore first person survival experience that takes place inside Ozyorsk, Russia after the Kyshtym Disaster. As a lone traveler, you must scavenge for resources, avoid anomalies, and fend off both hostile factions and creatures to survive.
